searches_used.note: WebFetch calls are not counted. No prior-cycle search was reused as new evidence.

results.name: Romania
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 35.6 (-1.9) is grid rounding. The live-sheep export ban behind the 15 Sept Bucharest protest is an EU measure, not Romanian conduct. Tear gas followed a cordon breach; the compensation law is still a draft, so plans are not scored.

results.name: Chile
results.key_finding: CORROBORATES EXISTING: measured 41.9 (-20.6) sits within grid noise of the PENDING chile-2026-09-01 proposal (42.5); no duplicate filed. One move: EQ5 3->2, because President Kast held no official commemoration of the dictatorship's victims on 11 Sept, a first since 1990 (EFE). Date mismatch resolved: events on 11 Sept, monitor published 17 Sept.

results.name: Boston Dynamics (SPOT demo)
results.evidence_attaches_to: Boston Dynamics company row (65.6), not the SPOT demo row; no conduct change on either row
results.key_finding: SCREENING NOTE ONLY: ICE's up-to-$2M Spot purchase is a procurement forecast ('the government has not yet issued an RFP for this', Boston.com 9 Sept), a third party's plan and not Boston Dynamics conduct. The company only restated its standing weaponisation ban and public-use-policy rule, which the company row already scores. Nothing filed on either row, so no conflict. The row is under open founder decision D23.

results.name: United States
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 16.3 (-1.2) is grid rounding. UN High Commissioner Turk's 7 Sept count of 23 ICE custody deaths in 2026 continues the pattern priced by the June downgrade. It is tier-4 evidence of concern, not an adjudication. The shock-glove item is a reported DHS procurement plan and is not scored (rule 3).

results.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (floor-limited): measured 3.1 (+0.8) equals the 09-01 sidecar. Tear gas, warning shots and arrests at protests against constitutional change land on subdimensions already at 1. Date resolved: protests on Tuesday 15 Sept; EWN/AFP published 16 Sept.

results.name: Bolivia
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 5.0 (-1.3). The 90-day state-of-exception extension (decree 14 Sept, Assembly approval 17 Sept, 100 of 158 votes) continues an emergency regime already priced. The state of siege was only contemplated and is not scored. The scan's English spokesman quote was not found in the source.

results.name: Starbucks
results.key_finding: CORROBORATES EXISTING: measured 43.1 (-5.3) equals the PENDING starbucks-2026-09-01 proposal; no duplicate filed. The 5th Circuit (4 Sept) upheld an illegal threat to deny maternity benefits but rejected the hours and hiring-portal claims. Mixed ruling; no move.

results.name: Diligent Robotics
results.key_finding: WITHHELD BAND CROSSING: measured 79.8 (Established, -3.2) vs 83.0 Exemplary. One move, AC3 4->3: MultiCare ended its 14-robot deployment ('The cost didn't justify their level of usage') and nurses reported no meaningful time savings. Not filed: the band-crossing sourcing bar needs a tier-4 source and none exists (tier 1-2 only), and the crossing hinges on the 4.0 weakness cliff in a never-assessed placeholder (rule 5). Identity: acquisition by Serve Robotics referred.

results.name: Imbue
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 81.1 (-0.3) is grid rounding; no independent evidence located. Exemplary status depends on seven dimensions at exactly 4.0; referred to the 4.0-cliff calibration cohort.

results.name: Jack Henry & Associate
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 77.2 (-0.7) is grid rounding. A 30 Aug 2026 ShinyHunters extortion listing is a criminal claim with no company disclosure located; it is watched, not scored.

results.name: Harmonic Bionics
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED: measured 60.6 (-1.9) is grid rounding and stays Established (Functional is 60.0 and below), 0.6 points above the boundary. Identity referral: Bioness Medical acquired the assets and business on 18 June 2025. The FDA MAUDE malfunction report with a customer alert supports AB3 at the published level.

not_assessed.name: Halodi Robotics
not_assessed.reason: Not assessed. The row is Halodi Robotics, renamed 1X Technologies in 2023, and is covered by the open waiver D13-1x-technologies (D-13 not ratified): three published composites for one entity (ai-labs 50, robotics-labs 81.4, Halodi 62.5). An assessment would add a record for a row that D-13 may retire. No file written; last_assessed not stamped.

scan_claim_corrections: romania: 'More than 1,000' protesters; Al Jazeera and France 24 say about 2,000. The export ban was imposed by the European Commission, not the Romanian government. Detentions: 26 (AFP, 15 Sept) vs 47 (Radio Romania International, 16 Sept).

chile (validator warning): the monitor URL date 2026-09-17 is the publication date; events were on 11 Sept (EFE and Meganoticias, 12 Sept). The student budget-cut claim rests on an advocacy source with no amounts; not scored.

democratic-republic-of-c (validator warning): protests were on Tuesday 15 Sept; the EWN URL date 2026-09-16 is the AFP filing time (03:26). The scan's '15-16 September' span is unsupported for 16 Sept. The allAfrica/RFI summary misdates the Tuesday as 16 Sept.

bolivia: the scan's spokesman quote 'we will use constitutional force, and we will use the military' was not found in the EFE/Infobae text. The verified quote is 'Si se ve pertinente imponer otras medidas, lo vamos a hacer, la ley lo contempla'. noticiassin 403; riotimesonline (date_verified false) not used. Post-scan: Assembly approved the extension 17 Sept.

boston-dynamics-spot-demo: 'began a formal procurement process' overstates it; it is a forecast and no RFP has been issued (Boston.com). The Boston Globe (08-29) and WBUR (08-31) sources predate the 09-03 lookback start.
starbucks: consistent with sources; the underlying Wichita conduct predates the window. The US News source timed out; BNN Bloomberg (Reuters) was used.

coordinator_notes_applied.placeholder_rounding: Harmonic Bionics (62.5 cohort) rounds to 60.6, which stays Established under the canonical band rule, so nothing to withhold. Diligent Robotics' crossing is conduct plus the 4.0 cliff; withheld on the sourcing bar and rule 5.
coordinator_notes_applied.rotation_backfill: Assessed 4 of 5 within a proportionate budget (13 searches total vs 26 last cycle).
coordinator_notes_applied.seed_baseline_discipline: Every report splits movement into baseline rounding and evidence moves (frontmatter grid_only_composite). Only two evidence moves were made cycle-wide: Chile EQ5 and Diligent AC3.

62.5 placeholder cohort: Chile (vehicle: pending 09-01 proposal) and Harmonic Bionics (rounds to 60.6, 0.6 above the Functional boundary). Study with France, Slovenia, Netflix and Bridgetown.
